wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 04-003 wires the existing read-only MainLoop class (src/mainLoop.ts) to live callbacks driven by the shared VanillaRuntimeContext from 04-001. The new src/vanilla/runDoomLoop.ts driver constructs a MainLoop instance, runs the four pre-loop steps in canonical order (initialTryRunTics, restoreBuffer, executeSetViewSize, startGameLoop), then iterates runOneFrame() up to options.maxFrames (default 60) or until a caller-supplied shouldContinue predicate returns false. The pre-loop restoreBuffer step zeros both 320x200 indexed framebuffers (primary and back) in-place. The per-frame phase bodies are placeholders that record their label in a phase log so the focused test can prove canonical phase order ('startFrame', 'tryRunTics', 'updateSounds', 'display') without depending on subsystem side effects. The MainLoop class itself is unchanged.
